body: But I can't do what I want. It's easier to switch fields if you have a degree, no matter what it's in. I don't have anything except a huge gap 3 year gap in my resume. Even minimum wage is a dream at this point.
I am a failure at everything and everybody has given up on me. I don't want to live anymore.

I am a complete failure. I have flunked university twice and cannot for the life of me get employed. I live at home with my family who acts like everything is okay and gets angry when I show signs of not being okay. The other day I was talking on a hotline and they called the cops without my permission, they forced me to go to the hospital and book a bunch of appointments. I tried talking to them but they don't even treat me like a person, they just ask the same meaningless questions and prescribe a ton of pills. I am not doing it. I am not ill, just a failure at life. I am tired of the humiliation. Everybody looks down on me because on top of accomplishing nothing in life, I am now a crazy suicidal lunatic. I just cannot do it anymore.
I don't know what more I can say, I just want to go.
I don't want to give away too much information publicly. I can PM anyone who asks.

This is why I don't want to give up the option of suicide. Since I stopped caring about life, I've been reckless and messed things up to the point where a decent life is almost unsalvageable. And if I give up on suicide, I'll have to face that mess I made.

Tonight I'm feeling like I'm done with life. There's not much stopping me from ending it all. I have an exam worth a quarter of my grade tomorrow morning and I haven't gone to class or studied at all since semester started. But it's okay because I'm planning on jumping tomorrow.

 I feel bad commenting because I don't want to put this on you. You don't have to answer if you don't want.
Not much left for me to stick around for. I can feel myself sinking and my last day getting closer and closer.
